Reconcile LiteLLM + monitoring stack (up + remove orphans)
Wait for model to be ready (bounded)

deads=0; for i in $(seq 1 120); do curl -fsS -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:30000/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; if [ -f /tmp/sparklab-model-launch.pid ] && ! kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/sparklab-model-launch.pid 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then deads=$((deads + 1)); if [ "$deads" -ge 2 ]; then echo "model launch process exited before the model was ready" >&2; tail -n 40 /tmp/sparklab-model-launch.log >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; sleep 5; done; echo 'model not ready after 600s (http://127.0.0.1:30000/health)' >&2; tail -n 40 /tmp/sparklab-model-launch.log >&2; exit 1
